hero.description: Upload a document online, select the print type, and pick it up when it's done. Simple, fast, and secure.

howItWorks.title: How it works?
howItWorks.subtitle: The entire process is fully automated. Follow these 4 steps and forget about waiting.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Upload PDF, Word, or images directly from your phone or computer.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Adjust the number of copies, color, and format. The price is automatically calculated.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Secure card payment allows for immediate processing of your order.
howItWorks.step4Desc: When you receive a notification that it's ready, just drop by for the finished material.

benefits.title: Why Go2Copy?
benefits.subtitle: Save time, avoid lines, and have full control over your printing.
benefits.point1Desc: Arrive only when the document is ready. Your time is valuable.
benefits.point2Desc: You know exactly how much you pay before confirming. No hidden costs.
benefits.point3Desc: Your documents are encrypted and deleted immediately after pickup.

quickInquiry.whyJoinTitle: Why It Is Good to Join

quickInquiry.whyUsersDescription: Customers use Go2Copy because it is fast, transparent and convenient: they can compare options, track orders and avoid waiting in line.
